record.paper: Bounding $χ$ by a fraction of $Δ$ for graphs without large cliques

dossier_meta.paper: Bounding $χ$ by a fraction of $Δ$ for graphs without large cliques
dossier_meta.statement_text: It is possible that Conjecture 1.3 is also true for the list-chromatic number, i.e., $\chi_\ell(G) \leq \left\lceil \frac{1}{2}(\Delta + 1 + \omega) \right\rceil$ for every graph $G$ of maximum degree at most $\Delta$ with no clique of size greater than $\omega$.
dossier_meta.context_text: After stating Reed's Conjecture 1.3 for the ordinary chromatic number and noting Reed's partial result as evidence, the authors remark that the same bound may extend to the list-chromatic number. The correspondence chromatic number is always at least as large as the list-chromatic number, so such an extension would be nontrivial.
